title: How Ganesha got an elephant's head.
lines: This is a story from India.
A very long time ago, on a high snowy mountain, lived the god Shiva and the goddess Parvati.
He sat very still and thought.
A child who would stay with her and protect her.
One day Parvati went to have a bath.
She took some clay from the river.
She made it into a little boy.
She shaped his arms, his legs, his head.
The little boy came to life!
I'm going to have a bath.
I won't let anyone in, Mummy.
He stood in front of the door.
With a stick in his hand.
He had been away for a long time.
But Ganesha was standing in front of the door.
You can't come in, he said.
My mummy says nobody can come in, said Ganesha.
Shiva was so angry that something very bad happened.
He only wanted to protect me!
He wanted to make it right.
He said to his helpers: Go to the forest.
Bring the head of the first animal you see.
The helpers walked into the forest.
The first animal they saw was an elephant.
A wise elephant with big ears and a long trunk.
Shiva put it on Ganesha's body.
From that day on Ganesha is the god of beginnings.
When people start something new, they pray to Ganesha first.
He clears all problems out of the way.
He became the cleverest and kindest god of all.
With the biggest ears for listening well.
